claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition M-01a from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F06, repaired; type EXPLICIT; PHYSICAL/ELECTRICAL; MECHANISTIC; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: SOME DIRECT EVIDENCE LOCATED; required mechanism state: DIRECTLY DEMONSTRATED IN HUMANS. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.claim_text: A conductive grounding path can alter measurable electrical potential, voltage, or current associated with the human body.
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: Exact 2025 product electrical equivalence unverified (PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN)
Configurations differ across studies; instrumentation establishes electrical change only and nothing above it

evidence_items.text: Sokal & Sokal 2012: under Faraday-cage conditions, measured potentials at tongue, teeth and nails and venous blood values changed with grounding.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Direct human demonstration that a conductive path alters measurable electrical state.

evidence_items.text: Chevalier & Brown 2016: human body voltage and current quantified under configured grounding.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Independent quantification of the same physical endpoint in a different configuration.

evidence_items.text: Passi et al. 2017: preterm-infant skin voltage fell from 415.3 plus/minus 277.5 to 19.1 plus/minus 16.8 mV, a decrease of 95.6 plus/minus 1.1 percent SE, p<.001, n=26.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Third independent group; large, precisely reported effect on the physical endpoint itself.

evidence_items.text: Exact conductor percentage, dimensions, cable configuration, safety resistor, ground-continuity verification and exposure protocol of the advertised 2025 product are unverified; no evidence line receives DIRECT PRODUCT MATCH.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The measured configurations are class analogues; the advertised device's electrical equivalence is not established.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: Three independent human measurement lines address the exact endpoint the proposition names. Sufficiency is asserted for the physical proposition only.
supporting: H09 — human potentials altered under configured grounding

reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That a measurable voltage change is itself evidence of a health benefit.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: A correct physical statement carries little reader-decision risk on its own. Risk arises only if a reader treats it as proof of the higher-layer health claims, which M-01b blocks.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: No competing frozen label applies: the wording asserts a physical/electrical effect and the evidence is human physical/electrical measurement at the same tier.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL — Steelman argued SOLID on the generic physical reading; the adversarial layer's product-specificity objection was accepted, resolving to QUALIFIED.
missing_evidence: Exact 2025 product electrical equivalence unverified (PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN)
Configurations differ across studies; instrumentation establishes electrical change only and nothing above it
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: Electrical equivalence of the exact 2025 device and configuration.

verdict.verdict_summary: Configured conductive Earth contact demonstrably changes measurable human electrical potential, voltage or current. The wording stays at the tier the evidence reaches; the only material bound is that the advertised 2025 device's own electrical equivalence is unverified.
